senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;גרר, cmp. בנו כרוך אחריו Ḥull. 78ᵇ) young animal, whelp, cub.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 926:1">Yalk. Job 926</cite> <he>עלה ג׳ אחד וכ׳</he> a young (R’êm) appeared in Palestine; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:13">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>גורא א׳</he> (corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>גּוּרִים</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:13">Ib.</cite> <he>גּוּרָיו וכ׳</he> his (the R’êm’s) whelps went into the ark.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:10">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>גבורה של … של גוריו</he> the strength of the lion and the daring of his whelps.—<he>גּוּר אַרְיֵה</he> pr. n. m., v. <cite ref="C00493"><he>גּוּרְיָא</he> II</cite>.
